---
title: "Introduction to Positron"
---

A short, hands-on walkthrough of **Positron**, the free editor for R and Python from Posit. By the end you'll have a project folder set up the NV OSE way and know your way around every part of the window.

## Overview

- **Audience:** Anyone who writes R or Python, including RStudio and VS Code users switching to Positron
- **Level:** Beginner
- **Duration:** About 45 minutes
- **Format:** Self-paced walkthrough, or a short live demo
- **Computer:** Windows (Mac differences are noted where they matter)

## Learning objectives

By the end of this training, you will be able to:

1. Install Positron and start an R or Python session.
2. Open a project folder, and set it up with the NV OSE folder structure, a README, and a `.here` file.
3. Create folders and files, and save them, from the Explorer.
4. Find your way around the panes, and match them to what you know from RStudio or VS Code.
5. Install extensions, including AI assistants your agency approves.
6. Start tracking a project with Git from Positron.

## Prerequisites

- A Windows computer where you can install software (or ask IT to install **Positron**, **R**, and **Python** for you)
- For Lesson 7: [Git for Windows](https://git-scm.com/download/win) and a GitHub account. See the [Git and GitHub training](../intro-to-github/02-setup.qmd).

| # | Lesson | Time |
